QuestInfo.name: Phantom, the Thief Hero
QuestInfo.0: Ask Tess where you can find Phantom.
QuestInfo.1: Tess says Phantom flies around Maple World via airship. \r\nHead to Ereve, where Phantom was first seen, and talk to Empress Cygnus.
QuestInfo.2: You've located Empress Cygnus in Ereve.

0.0: I need you to find Phantom... \r\nToo bad I don't know where he is!
0.1: I'm told he has his own airship, called the Lumiere, and he travels all over. You don't happen to own an airship yourself, do you?
0.2: Too bad. Then our next best bet is to head to Ereve, where he first appeared. Rumor has it that he stops there from time to time.

yes.0: Talk to #bEmpress Cygnus#k when you get there. She might have a lead on where to find Phantom.

no.0: What do you mean, 'no'? This isn't a joke! Don't be picky about which Hero I send you to!

1.0: Hello, Explorer. What brings you to Ereve?

yes.0: I see. I am saddened by your story and understand why you seek Phantom.

npc.0: Talk to #bEmpress Cygnus#k when you get to Ereve. She might have a lead on where to find Phantom.
